description: Request a DJ. Needs `bookings:write`. Two calls. The first changes nothing: it checks the arguments as the change would (a field this tool does not take is refused, by name) and answers a summary and a confirm_token. Show the summary to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token.

confirm_token.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call, the confirm_token the first call answered.

event_id.description: One of my events (`evt_` id) to ask for, instead of describing a new one.

extras.description: Extra slugs or ids I would like.

note.description: A note to the DJ. It is screened when the request is sent, and may be refused.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, such as America/Chicago.

name: request_booking
title: Request a DJ
